<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

[#40190](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40190) wired the fused QK-norm + RoPE kernel (`sgl_kernel.fused_inplace_qknorm_rope`) into Qwen3-MoE on XPU behind the existing opt-in `--enable-fused-qk-norm-rope`. Its A/B on Qwen3-30B-A3B (TP=4, 4x Arc Pro B60) showed +4.7-7.0% output throughput, -60% q/k-norm + RoPE stage device time, and no accuracy change (GSM8K 0.9414 vs 0.9460).
The flag is opt-in on CUDA for a reason that does not apply to XPU: on CUDA the unfused path already fuses RoPE with the KV-cache write (`fused_set_kv_buffer`), and the fused QK-norm path gives that up. `enable_fused_set_kv_buffer` is CUDA/HIP-only, so the XPU unfused path has nothing to lose. This PR makes the fused path the XPU default; everything else is unchanged.

## Modifications

- `arg_groups/fields/exec_.py`: `enable_fused_qk_norm_rope` becomes a tri-state (`Optional[bool] = None`, `BooleanOptionalAction`, `resolvable=True`), the same shape as `enable_dsa_fused_indexer`. `--enable-fused-qk-norm-rope` keeps working; `--no-enable-fused-qk-norm-rope` is the new opt-out.
- `arg_groups/platform_hook.py`: `handle_xpu_backends` declares `enable_fused_qk_norm_rope=True` when the device is XPU and the user did not choose, next to the existing XPU `sampling_backend` default.
- Docs: the flag's rows in `server_arguments.mdx` and the Ascend support table.

On every other platform the field stays `None`. Its two readers (`qwen3_moe.py`, `mellum.py`) use it only in `and` chains and truthiness checks, so `None` behaves exactly like the old `False`. No model code changes.

One visible difference: off XPU, `/get_server_info` now reports `enable_fused_qk_norm_rope: null` instead of `false`, matching how `enable_dsa_fused_indexer` reports.

## Accuracy Tests

No new numerics: the kernel and call site are the ones #40190 measured (GSM8K above). The nightly `test/registered/xpu/llm_models/test_xpu_qwen3_30b_a3b.py` (TP=4 GSM8K, threshold 0.90) now runs the fused path by default.

Resolution, checked through `prepare_server_args` + `resolve_once()`:

| device | flag | resolved |
|---|---|---|
| xpu | none | `True` |
| xpu | `--enable-fused-qk-norm-rope` | `True` |
| xpu | `--no-enable-fused-qk-norm-rope` | `False` |
| non-XPU | none | `None` (off) |
| non-XPU | `--enable-fused-qk-norm-rope` / `--no-enable-fused-qk-norm-rope` | `True` / `False` |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->
## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

Enabled by default on XPU and disabled elsewhere; `--no-enable-fused-qk-norm-rope` disables it. + `None` + Type: bool `--enable-precise-embedding-interpolation`

@@ -2384,8 +2384,8 @@ If the value is int8, you must also set the environment variable:DEEP_NORMAL_MOD `--enable-fused-qk-norm-rope` - `False` - bool flag
(set to enable) + `None` + Type: bool Special for GPU

@@ -330,8 +330,16 @@ class ExecKernel(msgspec.Struct):
         bool, "Not using ragged prefill wrapper when running flashinfer mla"
     ] = False
     enable_fused_qk_norm_rope: A[
-        bool, "Enable fused qk normalization and rope rotary embedding."
-    ] = False
+        Optional[bool],
+        Arg(
+            help="Fuse q/k normalization and rope rotary embedding into one "
+            "kernel. By default this is enabled on XPU and disabled elsewhere. "
+            "Pass --enable-fused-qk-norm-rope or --no-enable-fused-qk-norm-rope "
+            "to force it either way.",
+            action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction,
+            resolvable=True,
+        ),
+    ] = None
     enable_precise_embedding_interpolation: A[
         bool,
         "Enable corner alignment for resize of embeddings grid to ensure more accurate(but slower) evaluation of interpolated embedding values.",

@@ -119,6 +119,13 @@ def handle_xpu_backends(server_args: Any):
                 "_handle_xpu_backends",
                 sampling_backend="intel_xpu",
             )
+        # Enable the fused qknorm + rope by default as the fused q/k-norm + RoPE kernel is a pure win here.
+        if cfg.enable_fused_qk_norm_rope is None:
+            declare_resolution(
+                server_args,
+                "_handle_xpu_backends",
+                enable_fused_qk_norm_rope=True,
+            )
         # Decode graph is opt-in on XPU: unless the user explicitly set
         # --cuda-graph-backend-decode (or --cuda-graph-config), keep it
         # disabled so the default startup doesn't require graph capture.
